page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ise.large is an x86_64 general purpose server instance belonging to the Enhanced family. The virtual machine is configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at 2.7 GHz. System memory totals 8.0 GB, yielding a standard 1:4 core-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Virtualization is delivered through the KVM hypervisor.

Hardware provisioning does not include local disk storage, necessitating the attachment of cloud block storage for the operating system and persistent filesystem requirements. The instance features a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps and allocates zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Discrete graphics processing units are absent from this server configuration.

Given its balanced ratio of compute to memory, ecs.g8ise.large offers an efficient hardware footprint for moderate computational tasks without the expense of specialized accelerators. It is technically appropriate for entry-to-mid-tier web serving, API endpoints, microservices hosting, light background workers, development pipelines, and general enterprise application workloads.

This configuration is suited for containerized microservices, web application backends, staging environments, and standard enterprise business applications.
